#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    std::string email;
    std::cin >> email;
    
    // Replace first "at" (starting from index 1)
    auto it_at = std::search(email.begin() + 1, email.end(), "at", "at" + 2);
    if (it_at != email.end()) {
        email.erase(it_at, it_at + 2);
        email.insert(it_at, "@");
    }
    
    // Replace all "dot" sequences (starting from index 1, but not at very end)
    auto pos = email.begin() + 1;
    while (pos < email.end() - 2) {
        auto it = std::search(pos, email.end() - 2, "dot", "dot" + 3);
        if (it == email.end() - 2 && email.size() - (it - email.begin()) <= 3) break;
        
        if (it != email.end() && std::distance(it, email.end()) > 3) {
            email.erase(it, it + 3);
            email.insert(it, ".");
            pos = it + 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << email;
    return 0;
}

std::string convert(const std::string& s) {
    std::string result = s;
    std::string::size_type idx = 1;
    
    // Replace first "at" with "@"
    while (idx + 1 < result.length()) {
        if (result[idx] == 'a' && result[idx+1] == 't') {
            result.replace(idx, 2, 1, '@');
            break;
        }
        ++idx;

    idx = 1;

        if (result[idx] == 'd' && result[idx+1] == 'o' && result[idx+2] == 't') {
            if (idx + 3 < result.length()) {
                result.replace(idx, 3, 1, '.');
            } else {

            }

            ++idx;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
